The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 1.5) is also valid; the concrete lacks realistic weathering. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight compression, but the Router's identification of geometric/structural artifacts is more critical for this evaluation. The severity of the railing issue is moderate (2.5) because it doesn't break the overall scene coherence but is clearly unnatural upon inspection.
alignment_reasoning: The image is a high-confidence match for the 'prison' class (Top-1 logit 7.98). While it misses exterior features defined in the taxonomy, this is due to the camera angle (interior), not a generation failure. The visible elements (bars, concrete, tiers) are semantically correct.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from noticeable geometric artifacts in the complex linear structures (railings/bars), specifically merging and waviness (Router severity 2.5). There is also a lack of realistic surface texture/weathering on the concrete (Router severity 1.5). These issues prevent a perfect artifact score, but the image remains coherent and recognizable. The artifacts are localized to high-frequency details rather than global structural collapse.
